story.hero: A princess searching for her brother
story.conflict: Her brother was captured by an evil opposing king.
story.journey: She leaves her kingdom and searches the forest for a lead.
story.guide: A wise old man beside his hut points her toward the abandoned castle.

lines.speaker: Wise Old Man
lines.text: A royal traveller, this far into the forest? What brings you to my door, Princess?

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: The enemy king has taken my brother. I left our kingdom to find him. Have you seen his soldiers?

lines.speaker: Wise Old Man
lines.text: A company passed along the eastern road. They were heading toward the abandoned castle beyond these woods.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Then I must follow them. How do I reach it?

lines.speaker: Wise Old Man
lines.text: Keep to the path ahead, through the forest. The old tower at its end marks the approach to the castle.

lines.speaker: Wise Old Man
lines.text: The tower entrance is sealed by a broken picture. Put its pieces back in order when you reach it.

lines.speaker: Wise Old Man
lines.text: Be careful. Hostile creatures roam the road. Keep your blade ready, and save food for when your strength fails.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Thank you. Whatever waits ahead, I will bring my brother home.

lines.speaker: Wise Old Man
lines.text: Then go with courage, Princess. Follow the road east. May you both return safely.
